files.transformation: The 48987 reviewed bindings with this profile's identity; each binding records one executable-owned identity or rule consumed by the importer, and the generation subset is stored in the content pack. Since 2026-10-04 it also names the building constructor's construction-site exemptions (masters 357 and 1188, classes 51 and 54), read from the executable of the 48987 and 54800 builds. Schema 1.2.0 also names the eight executable-owned object and resource roles used by ordinary post-RMS fallback player starts. Schema 1.3.0 also names the perimeter farm completion roles (parents 1893 and 1897, the ordered children 1899 then 1900, and resources 289, 288, 237, 238 and 239), read from the executable of the 48987 and 54800 builds.
